Events

Yahan kis qisam ke events hote hain

Grace Event Complex ek event complex hai jahan shadiyon aur family events ka intizam hota hai.

01

Weddings

Shadi ki taqreebat ke liye Johar Town ke markaz — Khokhar Chowk — par waqay venue. Apni date ki maloomat ke liye rabta karein aur venue visit karke jagah khud dekh lein.

02

Family Events

Family gatherings aur khandani taqreebat ke liye bhi ye complex istemal hota hai. Event ki noiyat aur date bata kar tafseel maloom karein.

About

Johar Town me waqay event complex

Grace Event Complex, Lahore ke ilaqe Johar Town me G-4 block ke Khokhar Chowk par waqay hai — plot 460-461. Ye ek event complex hai jahan weddings aur family events mun'aqid hote hain.

Venue ki koi official website mojood nahi hai — ye page sirf ek demo hai taake aap ko address aur rabta number ek jagah mil jaye. Date ki availability aur event ki tafseel ke liye venue ko direct call karein ya WhatsApp par message bhejein.

Note: Ye venue Grace Fort Event Complex (Township) se mukhtalif hai — ye page sirf Johar Town wali Grace Event Complex ke bare me hai.
